findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached Hungarian endpoint mean-squared-distance and native endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

The observed learning window is [0.0,0.5] with 50 observed score times at 0.01 spacing, and the curve support is [0.0,0.49]; recorded affinities are removed and an equal score prior is used, so no decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied and last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

Continuous contrast functions over the observed support are non-polynomial (polynomial_accepted false) with relative node RMSE from about 0.29 to 0.78, multiple sign changes (4 to 10) and strong sign conflicts (1 to 9) across 14 independent batches; e.g. landmark_00_soft_mass has whole-window z 0.64 but first-rate z 9.27 and last-rate z -10.00, and landmark_00_local_dy has whole-window z -0.30 with first-rate z -72.37 and last-rate z 5.52. This supports a time-conditioned rather than constant contrast rule, but the curves are coordinate contrasts, not absolute reward targets.

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned contrast weighting within the observed window
hypotheses.falsifier: A constant contrast rule matches or exceeds the time-conditioned rule on held-out observed-node fit fidelity without additional sign conflicts.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dy contrast values at observed score nodes
hypotheses.scope: observed window [0.0,0.5], 14 independent batches, no extrapolation
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast rule over the observed window will track the observed sign reversals in landmark soft-mass and local displacement contrasts better than a constant rule, because the observed-node linear fits show large first-rate versus last-rate z reversals with no accepted polynomial.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied; recorded affinities are removed and an equal score prior is used, so final affinity benefit cannot be verified from the delivered evidence.

Only continuous_trends rows and clock/objective metadata were read; branch-adjusted, survival, increment, turnover, joint, regional and lineage tables were not inspected, so selection enrichment versus absolute geometric descriptors and survivor-bias questions remain unresolved.
Contrast curves are coordinate contrasts over predicted endpoint world coordinates, not physical interaction energies or evidence of neural-module causation.
No current study outcome data are available to this role.
